sections.h2: Where is Elk River, and why does that matter when I sell?
sections.html:
Elk River is the county seat of Sherburne County, roughly 34 miles northwest of Minneapolis and 37 miles southeast of St. Cloud, where the Elk River meets the Mississippi. The city covers 42.33 square miles of land, far more than the compact suburbs closer in, so a house here may sit in town, near the river or on a larger lot toward the edge.

The Census Bureau estimates 27,896 residents for July 2025, up 8.0 percent from the 2020 base of 25,840. That is a faster pace than the Census shows for Eden Prairie or Faribault, so demand for homes has been rising rather than shrinking.

  • U.S. 10 and U.S. 169 meet here and run together for about 12 miles toward Anoka.
  • Minnesota Highway 101 links the city to Interstate 94, about seven miles south.
  • Many residents commute to the Twin Cities. Census mean travel time to work is 27.4 minutes.

sections.h2: What does the Elk River housing market look like in the Census numbers?
sections.html:
For 2020 to 2024 the Census Bureau reports a median owner-occupied home value of $370,100, a homeownership rate of 79.2 percent, median gross rent of $1,283 and median household income of $108,741. There are 9,835 households, averaging 2.66 people.

Residents under 18 make up 24.8 percent of the population, and median monthly owner costs with a mortgage are $2,075, against $796 for owners without one. Median gross rent of $1,283 is the benchmark for anyone weighing whether to keep the house as a rental.

sections.h2: How did Elk River grow, and which schools do buyers mention?
sections.html:
The city was platted in 1865 and replatted in 1868, incorporated as a village in 1881 and reincorporated as a city in 1911. Its location at the river junction and on the old Red River Trail made it a trading point first. The Elk River Water Tower was added to the National Register of Historic Places in 2012.

The public schools belong to Independent School District 728. Wikipedia lists Elk River High School, Ivan Sand Community High School, Spectrum High School, the Salk and VandenBerge middle schools and four named elementary schools. St. Andrew's Catholic School and Solid Rock Christian Academy are private options. When you describe your house, mention the school district number, since parents search by it.

sections.h2: Does Elk River's climate affect how I should prepare my house?
sections.html:
It affects what inspectors and buyers look at. Wikipedia's climate table for the 1981 to 2010 period shows about 31.9 inches of precipitation a year and roughly 39.5 inches of snow, with January daytime highs near 23 degrees and a record low of minus 40.

That is a long heating season. A buyer will ask about the roof, attic insulation, furnace age and any ice-dam or basement-water history, so gather service records before you list or ask for an offer. Written records help in either sale route.

sections.h2: What disclosures does Minnesota require when I sell in Elk River?
sections.html:
Before the purchase agreement is signed, you must disclose material facts you know under Section 513.55. Separate rules cover radon (144.496), wells (103I.235) and sewage (115.55, subdivision 6).

The sewage rule is worth reading if your Elk River property is not on city sewer. You must say whether sewage goes to a permitted facility. If it does not, the disclosure must describe the system, include a map as far as practicable, note any abandoned system and attach any prior inspection report. A seller who knew of a problem and failed to disclose can be liable for the cost of bringing a system into compliance, with a two-year window for the buyer to sue.

The Minnesota statute also says a certificate of compliance for an existing septic system is valid for three years, which can matter if you have a recent inspection.

sections.h2: What are Elk River's rules for rentals and permits?
sections.html:
The city requires a license for every rental dwelling, including single-family houses, and licenses must be renewed and inspected annually. The rule that matters at a sale is Section 30-198 of the city code: a rental license is nontransferable and ends automatically within 30 days after closing unless the new owner applies for and receives a license.

A house you rent on a platform like Airbnb needs a rental license when you are not on site with the guests. Renting a room does not need one if the owner and no more than two tenants share all living space. The Rental Dwelling Licensing Division is at 763-635-1075.

For repairs, the city says a shed over 200 square feet needs a permit and permits lapse after 180 days without work or inspections. Residential permits that need plan review take about one to two weeks, and over-the-counter permits for roofing, siding or windows usually issue in one to two business days. The city's FAQ adds that an owner who intends to sell needs a state contractor license when performing work on more than one property in a two-year period. Elk River also says buyers can examine its permit records.

sections.h2: How do Sherburne County taxes and recording work when I sell?
sections.html:
Sherburne County's auditor-treasurer collects tax on real estate in two halves, due May 15 and October 15, and goes by postmark for penalty. Agricultural property is due May 15 and November 15. Questions go to 763-765-4350.

The recorder's office is at 13880 Business Center Drive NW in Elk River, phone 763-765-4420. When a deed is recorded, the state deed tax is 0.33 percent of net consideration under Section 287.21, and a Certificate of Real Estate Value is filed with the county auditor for a sale above $3,000 under Section 272.115. Ask your closing agent which of these the purchase agreement assigns to you.

sections.h2: What are my options for selling an Elk River house?
sections.html:
• Agent listing: reaches the widest group of buyers, takes weeks, and may involve repair requests after the buyer's inspection.
  • Private sale: you handle pricing, showings, disclosures and the contract.
  • Cash sale as is: the buyer purchases the house in its current condition, which can suit a rental with a license problem, a house needing roof or furnace work, or an inherited property.

Ask each option for a written estimate of your net proceeds so you are comparing like with like.

faqs.q: How long does it take to sell a house in Elk River?
faqs.a: It varies with condition, price and financing. A listing needs showings and a buyer's loan to clear, while a cash buyer can close when title is ready. Recording at the Sherburne County recorder follows closing, so ask your title company for the schedule.

faqs.q: What happens to my rental license when I sell in Elk River?
faqs.a: It ends. Elk River's code says a rental dwelling license cannot be transferred and terminates within 30 days of closing unless the new owner applies for and is granted one. Report the sale to the Rental Dwelling Licensing Division at 763-635-1075.

faqs.q: Do I need to disclose my septic system?
faqs.a: Yes, if the property has one. Minnesota requires you to state in writing whether sewage goes to a permitted facility, and for a private system to describe it, show where it is and attach any earlier inspection report.

faqs.q: When are Sherburne County property taxes due?
faqs.a: May 15 and October 15 for real estate. Agricultural property is due May 15 and November 15. The county goes by the postmark, so mail early. Call 763-765-4350 for payment options.

faqs.q: Can I sell an Elk River house that failed a rental inspection?
faqs.a: Yes. You can sell it as is, but tell the buyer about open violations. The city allows written extension requests before the abate-by date on a notice, and the licensing division can tell you what is outstanding.
